title: Success Stories
subtitle: Real Patients. Real Recoveries. Real Care.
overview: Every year, patients from across the world travel to India for advanced, affordable, and ethical healthcare. We are proud to have helped thousands of international patients get life-changing treatments — at a fraction of the cost compared to their home countries. From heart surgeries and cancer treatments to IVF success and post-surgery recovery, our patients’ journeys inspire trust and hope.

featuredStories.title: Heart Surgery – Patient from Kenya
featuredStories.story: I was diagnosed with severe heart valve disease, but treatment back home was too expensive. In India, I received world-class cardiac surgery at Medanta Hospital at one-fourth of the cost. The team supported me from visa to recovery. I’m now living a normal life again.

featuredStories.title: IVF Success – Patient from UAE
featuredStories.story: After years of failed attempts, I finally became a mother thanks to IVF specialists in India. The doctors were caring, the treatment was advanced, and the costs were affordable. I am forever grateful.

featuredStories.title: Brain Tumor Surgery – Patient from Bangladesh
featuredStories.story: When doctors in my country said surgery was too risky, I turned to India. The neurosurgeons here gave me a new chance at life. The facilities were world-class, and I felt safe throughout my journey.

featuredStories.title: Cosmetic Surgery – Patient from UK
featuredStories.story: I wanted cosmetic surgery but could not afford UK prices. India provided expert surgeons, modern hospitals, and amazing care at just a fraction of the cost. I came back home with more confidence and a big smile.

trustReasons: Transparent pricing with affordable treatment packages
End-to-end assistance: medical visa, travel, hospital, and recovery care
Partnerships with India’s top NABH & JCI-accredited hospitals
Thousands of international patients treated successfully
